name: Psychosilencer
body:
School divination [mind-affecting]; Level bard 3, inquisitor 3, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, unchained summoner 3, witch 3

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You impose a muffling silence into the mind of the target. The target must make a Will save or be unable to use Intelligence-based skills, unable to mak.

Intelligence checks, lose any telepathy they possess or ability to be communicated with via telepathy, gain a +4 bonus on saves against mind-affecting effects, any attempt to detect their thoughts fails, and have a 50% spell failure chance for casting any spells with Intelligence-based DCs or psychic spells with a thought component. On a successful saving throw, the duration is reduced to 1 round and the target is only subject to a 10% spell failure and a -4 penalty on Intelligence-based skill and ability checks but is not subject to the other detrimental effects.

Psychosilencer, Mass

School divination [mind-affecting]; Level bard 5, inquisitor 5, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5, unchained summoner 5, witch .

Targets one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as psychosilencer, except as noted above.
